blocks.content: Course: React Query: The Practical Guide
Here's what the finished TaskFlow project looks like:

src/api.js — all fetch functions
src/queryKeys.js — all query keys
src/TaskList.jsx — everything the user sees and does
src/App.jsx — renders TaskList
src/index.jsx — wires up React Query
Five files. That's it. Every concept you learned lives inside these five files.
🔜 Next let's see each file in its final state.
